subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Forbidden
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"forbidden"** means something that is not allowed or prohibited. (निषिद्ध)

 
 
• **Example: **Entering the restricted area is forbidden without proper authorization.
 
 
 
• **"Allowed"** refers to something that is permitted or accepted. (अनुमत)
 
 
• **Example: **Pets are allowed in this park.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'forbidden'** is **'allowed'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Protected **(सुरक्षित): Kept safe from harm or injury.

 
 
• **Example:** The wildlife reserve is protected by strict regulations.
 
 
 
• **Prevented **(रोक दिया गया): Stopped from happening or arising.
 
 
• **Example: **Measures were taken to prevent the spread of the disease.
 
 
 
• **Banned** (प्रतिबंधित): Officially or legally prohibited.
 
 
• **Example:** Smoking is banned in public places.
 
 

3f:Tc25,

The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
